title: pqc-fixtures Manifest
description: Machine-readable record of one pqc-fixtures generation run. This is the only contract between the CLI, serve, the GitHub Action, and any downstream consumer.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest format. Incremented only for breaking changes.

warning.description: Human-readable statement that every artifact in this run is insecure and test-only.

engine.description: The cryptographic engine that produced the artifacts. Recorded so users can audit their exposure to engine CVEs.

version.description: Version actually used for this run.

pinnedVersion.description: Version this build of pqc-fixtures ships. Differs from version only when the engine was overridden.

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the run.

chainDepth.description: Number of certificates from root to leaf inclusive.

validityDays.description: Certificate validity in days. Capped at 30 so fixtures expire (safety marker).

seeded.description: Whether --seed was used AND the algorithm supports seeded keygen. SLH-DSA is never seeded (ADR-002).

preset.description: The shipped preset this run came from. Absent when the request was assembled from flags alone. Presets are versioned data, so the version is recorded alongside the name.

modified.description: A flag overrode something the preset specified, so this run is attributed to the preset but is not what the preset alone would produce.

sizeEnvelope.description: Expected raw byte sizes from the AlgorithmProfile registry (FIPS 203/204/205).

minChainBytes.description: Smallest total DER certificate-chain size this request can produce: chainDepth x (signatureBytes + publicKeyBytes). gen asserts the real output against it.

path.description: Path relative to the output directory.

role.description: Position in the chain: root, intermediate-N, leaf, or chain for aggregate files.

bytes.description: Size of the file on disk.

signatureBytes.description: Raw signature length, asserted against the AlgorithmProfile envelope.

publicKeyBytes.description: Raw subject public key length, asserted against the AlgorithmProfile envelope.
